title: Vulva Obscura

description.main: Hanne Lamon's photographs of the vulvas of more than 100 women, made with a camera obscura and a Polaroid camera. Published by Hopper&Fuchs in Antwerp in 2025, with texts by Sofie Crabbé, Hannelore Van Bavel and Nina Van Eekert.
description.extended:
The Belgian photographer Hanne Lamon photographed the vulvas of more than 100 women with a camera obscura and a Polaroid camera, and this book collects the results.

In late 2023 she was still looking for sitters in Ghent, women willing to be photographed for the project. The pictures are close, warm in colour and soft in focus. The book sets out to show how much vulvas vary, from the mons pubis and labia to the clitoris and vaginal opening, and to take the shame out of looking. Texts by Sofie Crabbé, Hannelore Van Bavel and Nina Van Eekert accompany the plates, in English and Dutch. The book was launched at GUM, the Ghent University Museum, in October 2025. It runs to 208 pages, 21 × 27 cm, softcover, designed by Rita Ferreira, Jef Van Berghen and Giulia Boccarossa and published by Bruno Devos at Hopper&Fuchs in Antwerp.

Lamon (b. 1982) has photographed her own everyday life for two decades, working with film, unusual papers and darkroom printing. Her artist's book until the end ___ I will follow you, made with Devos when he ran Stockmans, printed some thirty images on very thin paper. For the series Feel me heal me she photographed women holding kundalini yoga poses, without showing their faces.
